[s0l0!-header][h1]The length Property[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

JavaScript arrays have useful[b] built-in[/b] properties and methods.

An array's [b]length [/b]property returns the number of it's elements.[code format="js" codeId="698"]var courses = ["HTML", "CSS", "JS"];
document.write([b]courses.length[/b]);
[/code]
[note]The [b]length [/b]property is always one more than the highest array index.
If the array is empty, the length property returns [b]0[/b].[/note]

resolved.title: 数组的连接
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Combining Arrays[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

JavaScript's [b]concat()[/b] method allows you to join arrays and create an entirely new array.

[s0l0!-header][b]Example:[/b][/s0l0!-header] [code format="js" codeId="699"]var c1 = ["HTML", "CSS"];
var c2 = ["JS", "C++"];
var [b]courses [/b]= [b]c1.concat(c2)[/b];[/code]
The [b]courses [/b]array that results contains 4 elements (HTML, CSS, JS, C++).
[note]The [b]concat [/b]operation does not affect the [i]c1[/i] and [i]c2[/i] arrays - it returns the resulting concatenation as a new array.[/note]

resolved.title: 游戏积分
resolved.problem_statement_md:
假设你正在玩游戏，通过游戏每个关卡后获得相应的积分。

现在给出的程序，输入了关卡数量，以及每个关卡的积分，并存储在数组中。
请完善该程序，计算通过所有关卡后的积分总和。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Array Properties & Methods[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

The player receives points after passing each level of a game.
The program given takes the number of passed levels as input, followed by the points gained for each level, and creates the corresponding array of points.
Complete the program to calculate and output to the console the sum of all gained points.

[b]Sample Input[/b]
3
1
4
8

[b]Sample Output[/b]
13

[b]Explanation[/b]
The first input represents the number of passed levels, -- in this case, 3 (the size of an array to be created). The next 3 inputs are the points awarded to the player for passing each level. The player gained 1+4+8 points for 3 passed levels, which is then output.

[note]Notice that the first inputted number can be used as length of an array.[/note]
resolved.hint_md: 注意，第一个输入的数字可以作为数组的长度。

testcases.explanation:
第一个输入表示通关卡数量，--在本例中是3。
接下来的3个输入是玩家通过每个关卡后获得的分数。
所以通过3个关卡获得了1+4+8分，然后输出13分。
